Subject: Re: Vendor gateway onboarding + Order Form redline (MedCure)

Thanks Dev — great to hear. A few quick notes from our side: we are on Coupa (not Ariba). I've attached the Coupa onboarding instructions our vendor ops team provided.

Coupa specifics:
- We require a completed vendor registration packet, W-9 (for US entities), COI (certificate of insurance) for vendors at this tier, and a signed Order Form.
- We prefer the legal name on the Order Form to match the W-9/EIN. If you have a DBA, include both.
- Once we have the signed order form and vendor packet, we typically issue a vendor code within 3 business days, then a PO within 1–2 business days after the code is active.

Question: our procurement team asked if Redwood can accept the following limited indemnity alternative (we'll paste language if helpful). Is that something Neha can look at?

Procurement contact (internal): procure_ops@medcure.com

Happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Best,
Samantha Li
Director, Procurement Operations
MedCure Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor gateway onboarding + Order Form redline (MedCure)

Dev / Samantha / team —

Thanks for the context and the Coupa packet. I reviewed MedCure's Order Form and prepared a redline (OrderForm_Redline_legal_v1.docx). High-level summary:

1) Indemnity: The original MedCure language is broader than we accept. I created two options in the redline:
   - Option A (preferred): mutual limited indemnity with carveouts for third-party IP claims tied to Model misuse; Redwood's exposure limited to direct damages and capped at the Order Form value for the prior 12 months.
   - Option B (compromise): Redwood accepts forward-looking indemnity narrowly scoped to data breaches caused by Redwood's gross negligence.

2) Data residency / processing: clarified that Redwood processes customer data for inference in the region(s) agreed in the Order Form; added reference to our Responsible Use policy and SOC 2 controls.

3) Termination for convenience: suggested 60 days' notice and pro-rated refunds for unused committed capacity (if applicable).

Practical asks for procurement: we need the legal name exactly as it will appear on the W-9; please confirm whether MedCure requires an additional master vendor contact and the remit-to address (these typically populate Coupa fields).

If MedCure's team is open to Option A, we can move quickly; Option B will require some escalation. I can be on the call with procurement tomorrow morning if helpful.

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: OrderForm_Redline_legal_v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 11:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor gateway onboarding + Order Form redline (MedCure)

Thanks — sequence and checklist from procurement:

1) Required before vendor code issuance:
   - Signed Order Form (final PDF)
   - Completed vendor packet (Coupa registration)
   - W-9 (US vendors) or W-8BEN (foreign)
   - Certificate of insurance (COI) naming MedCure as additional insured if > $50k annually

2) Optional but helpful: remit-to address, EIN, vendor contact, bank ACH details (used later for payment setup).

3) Timeline: once a complete packet + signed Order Form are uploaded to Coupa, vendor code is typically issued in 1–3 business days. PO creation follows shortly after. Holiday season may add 1–2 business day delay.

I created a vendor enrollment ticket in MedCure's Coupa instance: https://coupa.medcure.com/tickets/7582 — Ticket ID: 7582. I'll attach our recommended vendor-setup CSV you can pre-fill to speed things up.

Next steps for Dev: please confirm which legal option Redwood wants to present (Neha's Option A or Option B) so I can share the checklist with Samantha and kick the enrollment. Also please collect the W-9 and COI from MedCure as requested.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-setup-checklist.csv
